description: This file contains implementation code for container management within the WPEFramework, including classes and methods for container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and status checks, as well as singleton access patterns and logging initialization.

classes.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::IContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Interface for container administrator singleton access.

classes.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Implementation of container administrator managing container instances.

classes.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance with lifecycle management methods.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::IContainerAdministrator::Instance
methods.description: Provides singleton instance of container administrator.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on ID and search paths.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::Memory
methods.description: Returns memory info of the container.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor info of the container.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces of the container.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces container process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: WPEFramework::ProcessContainers::CRunContainer::ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover containers from previous runs.
